brief: A podcast player where episodes are constellations — listened ones glow, series form patterns

dominant_strengths: Evocative metaphor — glowing constellation dots over deep space create immediate emotional resonance and a memorable identity
Restrained palette of warm amber, cyan accent and dim grey on near-black achieves cohesive cosmic atmosphere
Bottom player bar feels native to media apps while preserving the dark canvas above for the visualization
dominant_weaknesses: No visible affordances: dots lack labels, hover hints or grouping lines, so series-as-patterns claim is invisible to users
Typography is utilitarian — episode title and 'Tech Talk' use generic sans with weak hierarchy and no celestial character
Behavioral wayfinding collapses; no way to distinguish listened vs unlistened beyond subtle glow, no progress markers or filters
fix_priorities: Draw faint constellation lines connecting episodes within a series so the pattern metaphor is legible at a glance
Introduce hover/tap states with episode titles, durations and listened-status to make stars actually navigable
Strengthen typographic system — a more editorial display face for episode title, finer metadata treatment
Add a legend or filter (series, listened, new) so users decode the sky without trial-and-error
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral and reflective pull from the cosmic metaphor, but behavioral usability is sacrificed because the constellation logic isn't readable or interactive.
rationale.intent_fit: Captures the poetic premise beautifully as a still image, but fails to express series patterns or listened-state differentiation that the brief promises.
